notes.title: DLC patch! Introducing update 2.1.7
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43039142/8283912bfca3a9d27d57cea32c4b98263793bdfd.png[/img]

Patch focused on fixing bugs that came with the DLC. The main bugs were related to achievements and stage ranking. We apologize to everyone who experienced any issues on the DLC launch day ✨

[list]
[*] Moon God [b]achievement added[/b] for achieving S rank in all levels
[*] Fixed bug that didn't deliver achievements correctly [b](especially for world 4)[/b]
[*] Final stage now displays your rank for each level separately, instead of averaging them
[*] [b]Removed achievement [/b]that required you to be crushed by a bat 
[*] Credits music now stops at the end
[*] It's no longer possible to reset after winning the stage
[*] Fixed bug where some stars didn't make sound when collected
[*] Now the game correctly counts how many levels you have passed when opening portal
[*] Particles and fog disabled for Android after most devices encountered issues with them
[*] Rank of final levels in secret world fixed
[*] Non-solid blocks in the game ending fixed
[*] Fixed two dead pixels on the statue [strike]noticed by someone somehow[/strike]
[*] Ending art slightly touched up
[*] Wander added
[*] Many other minor bugfixes
[/list]

[b]Moonleap [/b][i]2.1.7 [/i]update brings a number of fixes and tweaks to enhance the gameplay experience! Players can look forward to a smoother gameplay experience. We hope you enjoy! 🌜✨

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43039142/59d64dbee9237a08ac82bb5c50eeb61f8e5fd00d.png[/img]

[b]- Guselect[/b]

notes.title: Introducing Moonleap's 1.1 Update!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43039142/8283912bfca3a9d27d57cea32c4b98263793bdfd.png[/img]

We're excited to announce the latest version of [b]Moonleap[/b], with a number of bug fixes and new features that enhance your gaming experience. In this post we will talk about all the changes since version[i] 1.0.0[/i]

✨ [b]New Features:[/b]

[b]1.[/b] Level name now displayed in pause menu.
[b]2.[/b] Added Japanese (JP), Spanish (ES) and Italian (IT) language support
[b]3.[/b] Secrer Star 3 now displays visual feedback
[b]4.[/b] Snails now turn smoothly
[b]5.[/b] Full moon upon completing the game at 100% as a tiny reward for players.
[b]6.[/b] The hub was improved to make it more polished and easier for players to navigate, especially in the first world.
[b]7.[/b] Now small petals come out of World 3 terrain.

Additionally, now a Moonleap DEMO is available for everyone who wants to test the game before buying the full version!

🐞[b] Bug Fixes and Tweaks:[/b]

[b]1.[/b] Fixed hub stone door sound not playing if the player only completed 8 levels
[b]2.[/b] Redesigned star doors from cyan-white to reddish hue, a lighter color made players feel that the level was "more done" instead of "less done”
[b]3.[/b] Fixed visual glitch of gray snail falling
[b]4.[/b] Brighter pigeons to make them more visible and easier to track.
[b]5.[/b] Corrected alignment of level 30
[b]6.[/b] Tweaked running flowers animation
[b]7.[/b] Daltonism mode: corrected symbol on staircases
[b]8.[/b] Galaxy music now loops properly
[b]9.[/b] Secret stars can now only be collected in their respective areas
[b]10.[/b] “Ghost platforms” or “One-way platforms” are now more visible
[b]11.[/b] Screenshake no longer shows blue borders on screen
[b]12.[/b] Modified “last levels” to prevent players from getting stuck after falling into the ending
[b]13.[/b] Now it's impossible to perform two jumps at once when using two different jump inputs
[b]14.[/b] Fixed crash that occurred in the "jumpscare" level, there was a small possibility of the game crashing when the player died for the red flower
[b]15.[/b] Minor tweaks to various levels

[b]Moonleap [/b][i]1.1.1 [/i]update brings a number of fixes and tweaks to enhance the gameplay experience! Players can look forward to a smoother and more engaging gameplay experience. We hope you enjoy 🌜✨

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43039142/59d64dbee9237a08ac82bb5c50eeb61f8e5fd00d.png[/img]

[b]- Guselect[/b]
